newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Ahmsa outlines Q1 steel sales.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Ahmsa outlines Q1 steel sales.

text.p: Mexico steel company Altos Hornos de Mexico said on Tuesday its finished steel products volume rose 6.3 percent to 741,097 metric tonnes in the first quarter compared with 697,731 tonnes for the quarter in 1996.
The company said in a statement that its liquid steel production grew slightly to 893,741 tonnes from 873,029 tonnes in the year-ago period.
"The company's new painting line is expected to become operational in the second quarter of 1997, increasing production of higher-margin, value-added products," the company said.
Ahmsa also said its new coal-injection fuel system completed trial phases on Februray 27.
